text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Summer training camp starts today. While 
carrying luggage to the lodge with Biwa 
Hayahide—

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
......You guys arrived at the same time 
too, huh.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
"I'm gonna work super-duper hard at this 
training camp! Hard enough to win the 
Kikuka Sho—"

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Eeeek?! Taishin, you're being way too 
cold?!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Nothing. I mean, that's what everyone's 
thinking anyway.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
I plan on winning too. ...Let's have a 
good race.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, I can't afford to fall behind 
either...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, the Classic Year Summer Training 
Camp hailed its grand opening!
